lyrics:
[Intro: four slow piano chords, room tone, a dial tone]

[Verse 1: female voice, hushed, almost spoken]
It's me. Don't hang up. I know it's been
Twenty years, and I know what I said
I saw your daughter's picture, she's got your grin
I've had this number written by my bed

[Pre-Chorus: strings enter, voice lifting]
I was sure that I was right
I've been right and alone a long time

[Chorus: huge drums, voice at full power]
I've still got your number
I never took it out
I've carried it from house to house, from town to town
I was wrong about the wedding, I was wrong about the rest
I've still got your number
And nobody since has known me best

[Verse 2: quieter again, piano and bass]
Do you still take the long way by the water?
Do you still laugh before you get to the end?
I've told our stories to people who weren't there
It isn't the same. They're just my friends.

[Pre-Chorus: strings, voice lifting]
You don't have to let me back
I just couldn't not say that

[Chorus: huge drums, voice at full power]
I've still got your number
I never took it out
I've carried it from house to house, from town to town
I was wrong about the wedding, I was wrong about the rest
I've still got your number
And nobody since has known me best

[Bridge: choir-like backing voices, voice breaking]
Say anything
Say "who is this"
Say "took you long enough"

[Final Chorus: biggest, last line nearly whispered]
I've still got your number
I never took it out
I've carried it from house to house, from town to town
I was wrong about the wedding, I was wrong about the rest
I've still got your number

[Outro: piano, a breath on the line, "Took you long enough."]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 79 BPM, 4/4, F minor. Slow, dark and spacious, with a chorus like a storm.

VOICE: Female, a deep, smoky contralto. The verses are hushed and conversational. The chorus is belted with enormous power and long held notes. Backing voices sing wordlessly in the bridge. Another woman speaks the final line over the phone.

INSTRUMENTS: A grand piano playing slow block chords, a string section, a huge, reverberant kick and floor toms, a deep bass, timpani, a choir pad, a dial tone and line noise.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, piano and dial tone. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:48 Pre-chorus. 1:00 Chorus 1. 1:34 Verse 2. 2:08 Pre-chorus. 2:20 Chorus 2. 2:54 Bridge. 3:16 Final chorus. 3:50 Outro, a breath and the answer at 4:10.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2015 cinematic pop ballad: dry, intimate verses and vast, echoing choruses, drums enormous, vocal dominant.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The answer on the line, 'Took you long enough', at 4:10.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original calls an ex-lover. In middle age the unresolved break that haunts people is more often a friendship, and this version lets the phone be answered.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Nervous, confessing, pleading, forgiven.
